tracks.lyrics:
[verse]
Haul away, lads, we've got a PDF,
A thousand pages dense enough to make a grown man deaf,
We'll feed it to the press through `engrave/route.ts`,
And pray the Mistral winds don't make the pipeline wrecked!

[chorus]
Engrave the paper, boys, engrave the paper!
`cd site && npm install`, then we'll see her!
From arXiv link to fine-press beautiful edition,
Making paper beautiful — that's our only mission!

[verse]
The `press-prompt.ts` is loaded, the `pipeline.ts` runs hot,
We changed the cobalt orange mid-hackathon — forgot!
DeepSeek R1 JSON is one thousand lines of pain,
But `cat-companion.tsx` is purring just the same!

[chorus]
Engrave the paper, boys, engrave the paper!
`cd site && npm install`, then we'll see her!
From arXiv link to fine-press beautiful edition,
Making paper beautiful — that's our only mission!

[bridge]

HANDOFF.md says "HACKATHON DAY STATE" — midday, God help our lives!

But `ask-edition.tsx` is FANCY — never mind!

[chorus]
Engrave the paper, boys, engrave the paper!
`cd site && npm install`, then we'll see her!
From arXiv link to fine-press beautiful edition,
Making paper beautiful — that's our only mission!

[outro]
Haul away... haul away...
The cat and robot walk together into `press-run.tsx` today!
